title: Page heading of the plugin catalog. The word Marketplace is established in both languages and stays as-is (it is also the sidebar label).
subtitle: One sentence under the heading saying what the page is for: seeing what the CRM can do, and installing a plugin without touching a terminal. Not marketing — the operator is already here.
allInstalled: Line shown above a full grid when every catalog entry is already installed. This is the DEFAULT state of a fresh instance, so it must read as normal and finished, not as an error or an empty result. Glossary: plugin → wtyczka.
empty.title: Heading of the empty state — the catalog resolved to nothing at all, which is different from everything being installed. Short noun phrase.
empty.message: One sentence explaining why: the catalog names plugins that this build does not contain, so none can be offered. No apology, no action to take.
filter.label: Label of the category dropdown above the card grid, and its accessible name. Noun, 1 word.
filter.all: First option of that dropdown — no filtering. ≤2 words.
category.communication: Catalog category for plugins that send messages to people (Discord). Noun, 1 word.
category.marketing: Catalog category for newsletter and campaign plugins (Listmonk). Noun, 1 word.
category.automation: Catalog category for plugins that react to CRM events automatically (webhooks). Noun, 1 word.
category.ai: Catalog category for AI-assisted plugins. Abbreviation — stays AI in both languages.
category.integration: Catalog category for plugins connecting the CRM to another system (MCP). Noun, plural.
category.other: Catalog category for an installed plugin the catalog does not describe. Deliberately vague — it is a fallback bucket, not a promise about the contents. Noun, 1 word.
card.details: Button on a card opening the details modal. Noun, 1 word.
card.install: Primary button on a card for a plugin that is not installed. Imperative, 1 word.
card.installing: Same button while the request is in flight; the button is disabled. Ends with an ellipsis character.
card.installed: Status next to a green dot on a card for an installed and enabled plugin. Adjective agreeing with 'wtyczka' (feminine) in Polish. ≤2 words.
card.disabled: Status on a card for a plugin that IS installed but has been switched off in Settings. Must not read as 'not installed' — the difference is the whole point, because re-installing is impossible. Adjective agreeing with 'wtyczka'.
card.configure: Link on an installed card leading to Settings → Plugins, where configuration lives. Imperative, 1 word.
details.requiredConfig: Heading in the modal above the list of config keys the plugin needs before it does anything. Short phrase, ≤3 words.
details.configureAfter: One sentence under that list: these are set in Settings → Plugins, after installing. Mirror the Settings navigation wording used elsewhere.
details.docs: Link in the modal to the plugin's documentation on the public site. Opens in a new tab. ≤3 words.
toast.installed: Success toast after installing. {name} is the plugin's display name. Polish: keep the name at the end so it does not have to be inflected.
toast.alreadyInstalled: Toast when the server answers 409 — usually because another browser tab installed it first. States the fact; the card updates itself, so no action is asked for.
toast.installFailed: Toast for any other install failure. What happened plus where to look. No apology, no 'we'.
errors.load: Error banner when the catalog request fails. Noun phrase, no trailing period.
errors.forbidden: Error banner when the session lacks the integrations permission. Says what is missing and who to ask, and never implies the catalog is empty.
